top_cluster.headline: The FBI arrested an Albany, New York woman on charges of attempting to provide material support to ISIS after an undercover sting in which she allegedly sought help and explosives to bomb the New York State Capitol.
top_cluster.left_framing: The Washington Post frames this primarily as a law-enforcement success story — a sting operation that identified and neutralized a threat before any attack could occur, emphasizing the effectiveness of FBI process over the individual's ideology or motive.
top_cluster.center_framing: No center-positioned outlet was included in this comparison, so center framing cannot be assessed from the sources provided.
top_cluster.right_framing: Breitbart frames this as evidence of an ongoing domestic radicalization threat, emphasizing the suspect's alleged pledge of allegiance to ISIS and specific intent to commit mass-casualty violence, using personal identifying details to underscore the concrete, named danger.
top_cluster.left_omissions: The Washington Post's account omits the suspect's name, age, and the specific federal charge (material support to ISIS) that appear in Breitbart's coverage, resulting in a more procedural and less personalized account.
top_cluster.right_omissions: Breitbart's coverage does not emphasize the undercover sting methodology or frame the outcome as a law-enforcement success in the way the Washington Post does, and omits contextual framing around FBI process that might mitigate perceived threat severity.

blindspot_narrative: Right-leaning outlets are systematically avoiding stories that show Republican vulnerability (NK snubbing Trump's offer, GOP Senate seats sliding to toss-up) in favor of character-attack substitutes on Democratic candidates, and are heavily invested in syndicated ideological opinion pieces over hard reporting today. Left-leaning outlets, meanwhile, concentrate on institutional-accountability stories (ICE, data brokers, redistricting) but are largely silent on directly rebutting the policy-critique pieces (Medicare for All costing, wealth tax, RCV) that the right is running unopposed. Both patterns suggest each side is choosing offense on favorable terrain rather than defense on unfavorable terrain today.
